blurb: Mike provides guided fishing trips on Lake of the Ozarks for both novice and experienced anglers. Trips focus on catching bass and crappie for sport or dinner. Fish cleaning is available if guests want to keep their catch.
extraNote: If rain is in the forecast, to stay comfortable (implying trips may proceed in rain)
